primaryChecks.text: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

context.text: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
